footer.about: SmartDisc turns every throw into data. Built for Ultimate Frisbee. Powered by innovation.

hero.title: SmartDisc
hero.lede: SmartDisc is the first Ultimate Frisbee disc with sensors built inside, capturing distance, speed, and spin on every throw, automatically. Open the companion app when you're done and everything is already there.

ecosystem.title: Inside the disc, everything you threw.
ecosystem.lede: Every sensor is sealed inside the disc itself: nothing on your wrist, nothing to clip on. When you're ready to review, the companion app connects and every throw is waiting for you.

problem.title: Ultimate is one of the few competitive sports without data-driven training.
problem.lede: Players train, compete, and improve based largely on observation. The metrics that actually matter stay invisible, which makes real analysis and development hard.

items.p: Was your throw faster, more accurate, or more consistent than last week? Without data, you're just guessing.
Players put in countless hours of training, but the numbers that would show whether it's working are missing. Progress is hard to track or compare over time.
Coaches can spot strengths and weaknesses, but without measurable data, their feedback stays subjective and hard to back up.
Plenty of sports already use advanced analytics, sensors, and tracking systems. Ultimate Frisbee still doesn't have tools built for real-time performance analysis.

how.title: A disc that {highlight} what you did with it.

steps.p: SmartDisc pairs with the mobile app and gets ready to record. Setup takes just a couple of minutes, and then you're tracking performance right away.

steps.h: The disc captures everything. You just throw.
steps.p: Sensors built into the disc track speed, spin, distance, and flight characteristics in real time, without changing how the disc feels. That means you can use it in tournaments too.
The app visualizes every throw and shows players and coaches what actually happened. You can track progress over time instead of just guessing at it.

metrics.title: The numbers stop being feelings.
metrics.note: From two seasons of beta with club and college teams across three continents.

items.k: Players get feedback the moment they finish a throw.
No manual tracking. The disc logs it automatically during training.
Speed, spin, distance, and flight path, captured in real time.

items.a: All current orders are pre-orders. Manufacturing starts in winter 2026, approximately; the first discs leave Vienna in early summer 2027 and ship in the order placed. We'll send you a tracking-window email two weeks before your disc heads out.

items.q: Is the price now the final price?

items.q: Can I change my address before it ships?
items.a: Yes. Sign in with the email you used to reserve, then update the address from Pre-order > Shipping. We freeze the address two business days before dispatch.

items.q: Do you ship outside the EU and US?
items.a: Yes, to most countries. Shipping for the first wave covers the EU, UK, US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and Japan. Other regions open after the first batch lands safely.

items.q: Does the disc feel different than a regular 175?
items.a: It weighs the same 175 grams, with identical flight characteristics. We worked with the equipment committee on tolerances, and the sensors and battery are distributed so the center of mass is exactly where the disc council expects it.

items.q: How long does the battery last?
items.a: About a full day. At least 2 whole games. Drop the disc on the inductive dock between sessions and you'll never see a low-battery warning during a game.

items.q: Do I need to wear anything?
items.a: Nothing. The sensors live inside the disc itself, so distance, speed and spin attach to whoever last threw it. You can pass the disc to a teammate mid-warm-up and the next throw is still recorded.
For most sanctioned events, yes: the disc meets WFDF 175 g standards. We recommend keeping it in scrimmage and practice for now and checking with your local federation before a championship final.
Yes, rated for rain, mud and the occasional cleat. We do not recommend submerging it; the inductive coil prefers a dry rim.

hero.title: Built by players. {highlight}
hero.lede: SmartDisc started as a diploma project driven by a simple idea: bring data-driven training to Ultimate Frisbee. Combining engineering, software development, and a passion for the sport, we turned that idea into a real product.

story.title1: It started with a simple question: how can you improve a throw if you can't measure it?
story.body1: As Ultimate Frisbee players and technology enthusiasts, we noticed that while many sports rely on data and analytics, Ultimate still depends largely on observation and experience. We wanted to change that. What started as a diploma project quickly became an ambitious challenge: developing a smart disc capable of collecting real-time performance data without changing the feel or flight characteristics of a regulation 175 g Ultimate Frisbee. By combining mechatronics, software development, data analytics, and design, we transformed an idea into a working prototype: SmartDisc.
story.title2: Technology should support the game, not change it.
story.body2: We didn't want players to adapt to technology. We wanted technology to adapt to players. SmartDisc is designed to feel, fly, and perform like a regulation 175 g Ultimate Frisbee. The sensors work silently in the background, capturing performance data without affecting the game itself. Technology shouldn't interrupt the game. It should help players get better.

items.p: While working on Ultimate Frisbee training and performance analysis, we realized that players and coaches lacked objective data to evaluate throws and track progress.
We analyzed existing sports technologies, defined the technical requirements, and developed the first concepts for a smart disc capable of collecting real-time performance data.

The first electronic components, sensor systems, backend infrastructure, and app prototypes were developed. The focus was on integrating technology without affecting the flight characteristics of a regulation 175 g disc.
The first fully functional SmartDisc prototype successfully captured and transmitted performance data to the mobile application, proving the concept in practice.

SmartDisc evolved into a complete system consisting of intelligent hardware, data analytics, and a user-friendly mobile application, creating the foundation for future development and potential commercialization.

privacy.subtitle: How SmartDisc collects, uses, and protects your data.

s1.title: 1. Who we are
s1.body: SmartDisc, Baumhaselweg 2, 1120 Vienna, Austria ("SmartDisc", "we", "us") operates the website at smartdisc.at and the SmartDisc mobile app for iOS and Android. We are the controller of your personal data as defined under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

s2.title: 2. What data we collect
s2.visitorsBody: We collect only the data your browser sends as part of standard HTTP requests: IP address, browser and OS type, referring page, and pages viewed. This data is stored in server logs for up to 14 days for security purposes and then deleted. We use no third-party analytics, no advertising pixels, and no cookies beyond those strictly necessary for the site to function.
s2.customersIntro: When you place a pre-order we collect:
customersItems: Payment method details (processed by our payment provider — we never see your full card number)
s2.appBody: The SmartDisc app stores throw data (distance, speed, spin, timestamp) locally on your device. If you enable optional cloud backup in Settings, an encrypted copy is stored on servers in Austria (EU users). We have no access to the content of your throw data. The only data transmitted to our servers without your active opt-in is crash reports, which contain no throw data and are deleted after 30 days.

s3.title: 3. How we use your data

items.desc: — to process and ship your pre-order
— to respond to questions and warranty claims
— invoicing, tax records as required by German law
— server log data to detect and investigate abuse

s3.body: We do not use your data for advertising, profiling, or automated decision-making. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for their own commercial purposes.

s4.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
s4.body: We process pre-order and shipping data on the basis of {contract} (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We process server log data on the basis of our {legitimate} in securing our infrastructure (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Where you have opted into cloud backup, processing is based on your {consent} (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time in app Settings.

s5.title: 5. Data retention
s5.body: SmartDisc retains personal data only for as long as necessary to provide its services and fulfill legal obligations. Accounting records, invoices, and other tax-relevant documents are retained for 7 years in accordance with § 132 BAO (Bundesabgabenordnung). Where required by law or ongoing legal proceedings, data may be retained for a longer period. Email correspondence and support requests are stored only as long as necessary to provide customer service and meet legal requirements. Server logs and technical diagnostic data are retained for a limited period and automatically deleted when no longer required. Users may request the deletion of personal data where no legal retention obligations apply.

s6.title: 6. Your rights
s6.intro: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
items: Access a copy of the personal data we hold about you
Request deletion where data is no longer necessary
Object to processing based on legitimate interest
Receive your data in a machine-readable format (data portability)
Lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Datenschutzbehörde – DSB)
s6.body: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at smartdisc{'@'}mailo.com - We will respond to your request within the timeframes required by applicable law.

s7.title: 7. Cookies
s7.body: This website sets no advertising or tracking cookies. A single session cookie is used to maintain your pre-order login state and expires when you close your browser. No consent banner is required for this cookie under the ePrivacy Directive.

s8.title: 8. Third-party services
s8.body: We use a payment processor (Stripe, Inc.) to handle card transactions. Stripe's privacy policy applies to data you enter on the payment form. We use a transactional email provider (Postmark) to send order confirmations; your name and email address are shared with them for this purpose only and are not used for marketing. Both providers are bound by data processing agreements in line with GDPR requirements.

s9.title: 9. Changes to this policy
s9.body: If we make material changes to how we handle your data, we will send an email to active pre-order customers and update the "Last updated" date above. Continued use of the site or app after changes take effect constitutes acceptance.
